title: Narrowed acceptance interval, 2x2 crossover

source.method_note: Exact method in PowerTOST; non-central t approximation here.

notes: Exercises the narrowed 90.00-111.11 interval used by EMA for AUC of an NTI drug, as pure arithmetic. It is NOT a regulatory validation of the EMA rule itself - that needs a tier-1 source.
